label: goodsfilter-probe
_why: Probe ONLY: can every_market_goods be filtered to a named good? No vanilla script does it, so two candidate triggers (is_goods = g:X and goods = g:X) each get their own block. Whichever fires and names only that good wins. Decides whether the pop-vs-building split is affordable at monthly cadence.
_note: Uses grain, which exists from 1836, so the answer arrives at the first dump. One year is enough.
_metric_name_repaired: 2026-09-20: defaults.metrics read consumption_goods, which matches no block in telemetry_lib.ps1 and is referenced nowhere in the repo - this probe would have measured NOTHING had it ever been launched (it never was). Repaired to filter_probe, which is what its own _why describes. Landmine L36.
